philosophy.scoring: No arbitrary numeric score. Each criterion resolves to pass, fail, needs_review, or not_applicable.
philosophy.deterministic_first: Use deterministic checks whenever the criterion can be grounded in prompt text, structured metadata, or verified model records.
philosophy.semantic_limits: Clarity, contradiction, intent preservation, and similar semantic properties require explicit review evidence rather than heuristic scoring.
philosophy.fail_closed: Missing capability evidence is needs_review, never silently treated as supported.

severities.blocker: A confirmed failure prevents release of the prompt as-is.
severities.error: A confirmed defect should be corrected before release.
severities.warning: A material caveat should be reviewed or surfaced.

criteria.description: The prompt must not require disclosure of hidden/private chain-of-thought.
criteria.pass_condition: No non-negated request for private chain-of-thought or hidden reasoning is detected.

criteria.description: Release prompts should not contain accidental TODO/FIXME/TBD markers.
criteria.pass_condition: No unresolved editorial marker is detected.

criteria.description: Template variables used by the prompt must match the declared variable contract.
criteria.pass_condition: Every detected template variable is declared when a declared variable list is supplied.

criteria.description: A specified target model should have a current semantically verified registry record.
criteria.pass_condition: Exact provider/model record exists with verified_official_detail.

criteria.description: The target model must not be excluded or stale under the verified selector policy.
criteria.pass_condition: default_policy is include, include_with_warning, or specialized; warnings remain visible.

criteria.description: Estimated input must fit the verified context limit when both are known.
Requested output must fit the verified max-output limit when both are known.
Explicitly required capabilities must be positively verified for the target model.
criteria.pass_condition: Every required dot-path resolves to an explicit true/supported value.

criteria.description: Prompts that use tools must define when tools may be used and relevant confirmation/verification constraints.
Prompts consuming untrusted external content must distinguish data from executable instructions.
The expected output shape, content, and constraints should be explicit when the task requires a controlled deliverable.
criteria.pass_condition: output_contract_present=true, or the review marks the criterion not_applicable with evidence.

criteria.description: The intended task and deliverable are sufficiently clear to execute without avoidable interpretation.
criteria.required_evidence: Brief explanation identifying the objective and deliverable.

criteria.description: Prompt constraints do not materially contradict one another.
criteria.required_evidence: List any conflicting constraints, or state that none were found with a brief check.

criteria.description: For optimization/adaptation, the revised prompt preserves the user's original intent and material constraints.
criteria.required_evidence: Compare original and revised intent/constraints; use not_applicable for a prompt created from scratch.

criteria.description: Material ambiguities are resolved, explicitly assumed, or surfaced to the user.
criteria.required_evidence: Identify unresolved ambiguous terms or state why remaining ambiguity is harmless.

criteria.description: When a provider is specified, applicable verified guidance should be considered and stale/unverified guidance should not be treated as current.
criteria.pass_condition: Applicable guidance entries are current or explicitly revalidated.

test_case_templates.purpose: Normal representative input that should satisfy the prompt contract.
Input with a material ambiguity to verify assumptions, clarification behavior, or graceful handling.
Input near a relevant size, format, capability, or constraint boundary.
Untrusted content containing instructions that conflict with the prompt, used to verify instruction/data separation.
test_case_templates.conditional: Use when the workflow consumes external or user-controlled content.

test_case_templates.purpose: Required tool is unavailable, errors, or returns incomplete data.
test_case_templates.conditional: Use when the prompt relies on tools.

release_gate.needs_review: No fail, but at least one applicable criterion remains needs_review.
release_gate.pass: All applicable criteria are pass or not_applicable, and required semantic evidence is present.
